pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: You are advising a mid-market e-commerce company that wants to build a GenAI-powered content pipeline to produce personalized product recommendation emails at scale — different copy for different customer segments, generated automatically and sent daily. They have a solid first-party data asset (purchase history, browse behavior, email engagement) and a small but capable engineering team. They use a major cloud email platform and want to stay within it where possible. Walk me through how you would design this pipeline end to end: what the key components are, how you would handle personalization at the content-generation layer, how you would measure whether the AI-generated content is actually performing better than their current templated emails, and what guardrails you would put in place to protect the brand and avoid compliance risk. Where are the hardest tradeoffs in this design?
